title: Overview: Doc limits
snippet:
API rate limits are not plan-dependent. The following limits apply to Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans. Limits apply per-user across all endpoints that share the same limit and across all docs.
- Reading data (with the exceptions below): 100 requests per 6 seconds
- Writing data (POST/PUT/PATCH): 10 requests per 6 seconds
- Writing doc content data (POST/PUT/PATCH): 3 requests per 10 seconds
- Listing docs: 4 requests per 6 seconds
- Reading analytics: 100 requests per 6 seconds

title: Intro to the Admin API
snippet:
The Coda Admin API is a RESTful API that allows programmatic access to administrative reports and capabilities within Coda. Enterprise admins can use the Admin API to view and modify policies, integrate with a DLP or e-discovery tool your company may use, view audit logs, and more.

Who can use the Admin API?
Only [org admins](https://coda-docs.zendesk.com/hc/articles/39555906605965) on an Enterprise plan have access to Coda’s Admin API.

title: docs.coda.co/payout/integration-guides/getting-started.md
snippet:
**Step 1**: Get your Coda publisher account and credentials
Before you start integrating, you will need a **Coda publisher account**, **an API Key**, **a partnerId and client secret** to be able to send authenticated requests in each environment (Sandbox and Production).
If you don’t already have a Coda publisher account, you can reach out to the integration support team to get one. If you already have an account, you can just reuse it.
Once you have an account, you will need to get your API key. You can request the **APIkey**, **partnerId**, and **client secret** from the integration support team.

title: Connect to the Coda MCP
snippet:
In most cases, you will need to use Personal Access Tokens to complete the connection.
To acquire these access tokens from Coda, you can [click here](https://coda.io/account?openDialog=CREATE_API_TOKEN&scopeType=mcp#apiSettings) (or scroll to the **API settings** section of your account page, then click **Generate API token**). Give your token a memorable name, ensure that the restriction type is **MCP**, and choose the type of access. Then click the** Generate API token** button to create. Once created, click the **Copy token** button to copy it to your clipboard.

title: Authenticating with Packs | Coda Help Center
snippet:
In order to enable the Greenhouse Recruiting / Coda integration, you will need the developer permission **Can manage ALL organization’s API Credentials**.

In the Create New Credential dialog box, make the following selections:
- **API Type**: Harvest
- **Partner**: Coda
- **Description**: *Coda Harvest API Key*

To create your API Key and Password:
1. From your Shopify Admin, go to **[Apps](https://www.shopify.com/admin/apps)**.
2. Click **Manage** custom apps.
3. Click **Create** new custom app.
4. In the Description section, enter "Coda" for the name of the custom app and add your email address as a contact email.
5. In the Permissions section, select "Read and Write" access for Customer, Orders, Products, and Inventory data, as well as "Read" access for Locations data.**
